rationale: C12 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Both directives first explain why a contemplated organizational arrangement is appropriate, then designate one civilian agency to lead planning, require that agency to work with other responsible governmental bodies, request development of a concrete program and recommendations, and close by noting that a copy is being sent to the relevant defense secretary. C03 and C05 contain weaker versions of the lead-agency, interagency-cooperation, and copied-recipient structure, but they lack C12's close planning-and-recommendation sequence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: it is my desire that realistic planning be undertaken immediately... Accordingly, I request that you take the lead, in cooperation with the Secretary of the Navy, in developing a specific time schedule
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I would like, therefore, for the Board to assume such leadership in civil defense planning and to develop a program... [and] call upon the other agencies of the Government
shared_material.explanation: Both assign a lead agency responsibility for developing a planning program while expressly involving other responsible agencies.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I further request that you advise me by September 1, 1949, of the plans recommended under the aforementioned procedure.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I would like the Board's recommendations concerning necessary actions, including any legislative proposals which may need early attention.
shared_material.explanation: Each culminates in a request for recommendations or plans resulting from the assigned interagency planning process.

shared_material.child_excerpt: A copy of this letter is being sent to the Secretary of the Navy.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am sending a copy of this memorandum to the Secretary of Defense so that he may be informed concerning the conclusions contained herein.
shared_material.explanation: The nearly parallel closing notice reinforces the common administrative drafting structure, though it would be routine if standing alone.
